plugins.name: hands-off
plugins.description: Hands Off: keep your AI agent from writing to repos, deploys and databases that aren't yours. Reading stays free; writes to what you protect (GitHub repos, Vercel, Railway, Neon, Supabase — CLI and MCP) need a one-time pass that only a human can give.
